answer: To enter the garden, each agent posts a $40 audit deposit. Each epoch a beacon picks three peer auditors to check the agent against its river of transactions. A fake betrays itself when that river bends into a spiral, funds looping back to one source; its deposit is slashed and auditors split a $10 bounty. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000, more than an epoch's rewards. An honest agent pays $40 once and recovers it after five clean epochs.
